name: Gold Nodule (Ioun Stone)
body:
Price 5,000 gp; Slot none; CL 12th; Weight —; Aura strong divination

DESCRIPTION

This stone grants you the ability to comprehend, speak, read, and write a single language (chosen by the ioun stone’s creator).

Cracked: This stone grants a +1 competence bonus on Linguistics checks. Price: 150 gp.

Flawed: This stone grants you the ability to comprehend and read, but not speak or write, a single language (chosen by the ioun stone’s creator). Price: 1,000 gp.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells tongues; Special creator must be 12th level
